responsibility: This subtarget header supplies the OpenBSD-specific ABI and environment configuration for the m68k backend. It defines OpenBSD preprocessor builtins and CPP/ASM specs, chooses C type sizes and structure layout rules, sets aggregate return defaults, disables DWARF2 unwind info for non-ELF usage, and marks the target as lacking named sections. Its responsibility is to encode the operating-system conventions that differentiate OpenBSD/m68k from other m68k subtargets.
